question: Who founded Atlas Dynamics?
cypher: MATCH (p:Entity)-[:FOUNDED]->(:Entity {name:'Atlas Dynamics'}) RETURN p.name AS answer

question: Which companies has Cedar Capital invested in?
cypher: MATCH (:Entity {name:'Cedar Capital'})-[:INVESTED_IN]->(c:Entity) RETURN c.name AS answer

question: Which companies partner with Orion Cloud?
cypher: MATCH (:Entity {name:'Orion Cloud'})-[:PARTNERS_WITH]-(c:Entity) RETURN DISTINCT c.name AS answer

question: Which investors have funded companies that partner with Orion Cloud?
cypher: MATCH (:Entity {name:'Orion Cloud'})-[:PARTNERS_WITH]-(c:Entity)<-[:INVESTED_IN]-(i:Entity) RETURN DISTINCT i.name AS answer

question: Who works for the company that acquired Sahara Analytics?
cypher: MATCH (:Entity {name:'Sahara Analytics'})<-[:ACQUIRED]-(a:Entity)<-[:WORKS_FOR]-(p:Entity) RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS answer

question: Which people studied at the Rabat Institute of Technology?
cypher: MATCH (p:Entity)-[:STUDIED_AT]->(:Entity {name:'Rabat Institute of Technology'}) RETURN p.name AS answer

question: Which companies employ alumni of the Rabat Institute of Technology?
cypher: MATCH (:Entity {name:'Rabat Institute of Technology'})<-[:STUDIED_AT]-(p:Entity)-[:WORKS_FOR]->(c:Entity) RETURN DISTINCT c.name AS answer

question: In which cities are the companies that Cedar Capital invested in located?
cypher: MATCH (:Entity {name:'Cedar Capital'})-[:INVESTED_IN]->(:Entity)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(l:Entity) RETURN DISTINCT l.name AS answer

question: Which technology is used by the most companies?
cypher: MATCH (t:Entity:Technology)<-[:USES]-(c:Entity) WITH t, count(DISTINCT c) AS n ORDER BY n DESC WITH collect({t:t, n:n}) AS all WITH [x IN all WHERE x.n = all[0].n | x.t.name] AS answers UNWIND answers AS answer RETURN answer

question: Which people collaborate with someone who works for Atlas Dynamics?
cypher: MATCH (p:Entity)-[:COLLABORATES_WITH]-(q:Entity)-[:WORKS_FOR]->(:Entity {name:'Atlas Dynamics'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS answer

question: Which products are developed by competitors of Atlas Dynamics?
cypher: MATCH (:Entity {name:'Atlas Dynamics'})-[:COMPETES_WITH]-(c:Entity)-[:DEVELOPS]->(p:Entity) RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS answer

question: How are Karim Benali and Sophie Laurent connected?
cypher: MATCH (a:Entity {name:'Karim Benali'}), (b:Entity {name:'Sophie Laurent'}) MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:{REL}*..6]-(b)) UNWIND nodes(p)[1..-1] AS n RETURN n.name AS answer
